exercises.name: Flutter Kicks

source_english.description: Flutter Kicks alternate small straight-leg beats from the hips while the lower back stays controlled.
instructions: Lie on your back with legs extended and the lower back gently braced.
Lift the heels slightly off the floor and keep the legs long.
Alternate small up-and-down kicks from the hips.
Stop before the back arches and rest with control.
source_english.safety_note: Raise the legs higher if the lower back cannot stay gently supported.

instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended and your lower back gently braced.
Lift your legs slightly off the floor and keep them straight.
Cross one leg over the other, then switch the top leg in a smooth scissoring motion.
Continue alternating while keeping your ribs down and lower back controlled.

Moving too quickly to control the crossing.

exercises.name: Pike Pushup

source_english.description: A pike push-up presses from an inverted-V position with the hips high and the shoulders doing most of the work.
instructions: Start in a pike with hands shoulder-width apart, hips high, and heels lifted as needed.
Brace the core and bend the elbows to lower the head toward the floor between the hands.
Press through the palms to straighten the arms and return to the pike.
Repeat without shifting into a flat push-up.
form_cues: Move the head between the hands.
common_mistakes: Bouncing the head toward the floor.
source_english.safety_note: Use a reduced range or elevated hands if the shoulders cannot control the descent.

exercises.name: One Arm Push Up

source_english.description: With one hand supporting the body in a plank, lower the chest and press back up without rotating the hips.
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and one hand placed slightly wider than the other.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your back straight.
As you lower yourself, shift your weight to one side and lift the opposite arm off the ground, extending it straight out to the side.
Push through your chest and triceps to raise your body back up to the starting position, while simultaneously lowering your extended arm back to the ground.
Repeat the movement, alternating the arm you extend with each repetition.
form_cues: Keep wrists stacked over the elbows.
Brace the trunk and keep the shoulder blades controlled.
Use a smooth lower and press.
source_english.safety_note: Use a stable setup and stop before the shoulders or wrists lose controlled alignment.

exercises.name: Hollow Rock

source_english.description: A hollow rock holds the lower back down in a curved hollow-body position while the body rocks gently from shoulders toward hips.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and arms extended overhead.
Brace your abdominals and lift your shoulders and heels slightly so your body forms a shallow curve.
Press your lower back into the floor and rock gently from shoulders toward hips without changing shape.

source_english.description: V Up curls the trunk and legs together from a supine position until the hands approach the feet.
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight and arms overhead.
Brace the abdomen and raise the straight legs and upper back together.
Reach the hands toward the feet at the top without pulling the neck.
Lower the legs and shoulders together until they nearly touch the floor.

exercises.name: Jackknife Sit Up

source_english.description: From a supine start with arms overhead and legs long, lift the torso and legs together and reach toward the toes.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms overhead.
Engage your core and lift your legs and upper body simultaneously, reaching your hands towards your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs and upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
form_cues: Keep the feet and lower back controlled while the torso curls toward the knees.
source_english.safety_note: Use a comfortable range and stop if control or alignment deteriorates.
